7.3 Using Library API
[SWS_BMC_00007]
Upstream requirements: SRS_LIBS_00004
⌈The Bmc API can be directly called from BSW modules or SWCs. No port definition
is required. It is a pure function call.⌋
[SWS_BMC_00008]
Upstream requirements: SRS_LIBS_00007
⌈Using a library should be documented. If a BSW module or a SWC uses a library,
the developer should add an ImplementationDependencyOnArtifact in the BSW/SWC
template. minVersion and maxVersion parameters correspond to the supplier version.
In case of an AUTOSAR library, these parameters may be left empty because a SWC
or BSW module may rely on a library behavior, not on a supplier implementation. How-
ever, the SWC or BSW modules shall be compatible with the AUTOSAR platform where
they are integrated.⌋
The user has to ensure that atomic data are allocated in a memory which allows atomic
access. Hence it might be useful to use a vendor specific but unique {refinement}
keyword in the memory allocation keyword (MAKW) or respective software addressing
methods (SwAddrMethod) which can be used to derive according MemoryAllocation
options for the purpose of mapping.
